title: Review of c02's FCH field chemoton on fresh seed 9: S, I and B replicate (every vesicle carries the gated catalyst as a beaded layer on its outer bilayer, t~100-600); the feed-cut fork replicates but E holds by construction
summary: Re-ran world.py on seed 9 (rerun/seed9, t=600) and world_starve.py on seed 9 (starve/seed9, feed cut at t=300). From the noisy bath, three closed vesicles (one concentric multilamellar, two with inner lamellae) form by t~100 and persist unchanged to t=600 at bounded size (5 components from t=300). Unlike the author's seed 1 and the strip reported on another fresh seed, here every vesicle carries K: K sits as beaded arcs and a continuous ring on the outermost bilayer (channels_seed9.png), K rim/core 3.61 and rim/outside 2.69, K membrane-like in 15/23 individuals. K is made by its own autocatalysis (aK^2P) and exists only on bilayers (zero in the bath), so the bodies make the layer themselves; the min-face mobility gate written against u holds it there. Feed cut at t=300: total amphiphile 5044 -> 351 by t=600 and the vesicles shrink to small rings and a micelle cluster, while the fed twin rises to 5272 (starve_fork_seed9.png). E is by construction: amphiphile is made only by K from the precursor and decays everywhere at kap.

observations.S: rerun/seed9/sheet.png t=0: uniform noise over the whole domain; vesicles by t~81
observations.I: rerun/seed9/sheet.png t=100-600: three closed vesicles persist unchanged at constant size, 4 persistent tracks
observations.B: channels_seed9.png row 3: K beaded on the outer bilayer of all three vesicles from frame 67 to 200; FACTS: catalyst K rim/core 3.61, rim/outside 2.69, membrane-like in 15/23 individuals; top track #17 (ring, t=399) membrane-like in both u+1 and K
observations.E: starve_fork_seed9.png: feed cut at t=300, amphiphile total 5044 -> 351 by t=600 and vesicles shrink to rings and a micelle cluster, fed twin 5272

controls_run.E: starve/seed9 (world_starve.py, precursor feed cut at t=300) against rerun/seed9 (identical until t=300)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. The K layer here covers every vesicle, but other seeds (the author's seed 1, a reviewer's seed 4) put K on an open strip with K-free rings, so how often K sits on the bodies varies with the seed; I did not run the nogate or noK controls. E is by construction (amphiphile made only from the precursor via K, plus a decay term). No division and no resolution test.
